BiblicalUsage: Susi is the father of Gaddi, one of the twelve spies sent into Canaan. His name appears once, in the list of the spies and their fathers. His son sees the land and brings back a report that frightens the people.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Susi matters because the spies' fathers are named, and the unbelief that follows is traced to real men.
RelatedEvents: The Twelve Spies and Israel's Unbelief
